---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear, one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What currently frustrating or missing?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature in enough detail to implement it. If it involves a new Gemini tool, describe the tool name, parameters, and what the backend handler would do.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you considered and why you chose this one.

## Additional Context

Mockups, examples, related issues, or anything else that helps explain the request.
